sections.text:
# Providence Day School — Summer Programs Research (2026)

Provenance header
- Compiled: August 11, 2026, for the Summer Programs research-area build (two cards:
 The Camp Catalog, The Summer Cost Planner).
- Primary source: the school's official **2026 Camp Brochure PDF** (8 pp., Adobe
 InDesign, created 2025-12-11), cross-checked against the live/archived summer site.
 All figures copied char-for-char.
- Where the school publishes nothing, this file says NOT PUBLISHED rather than
 estimating.

**Method note on the brochure.** The brochure's session grid encodes weeks as Wingdings
glyphs. They were decoded from the PDF's per-word x-coordinates against the legend
(`0xf06c`=Morning, `0xf06e`=Afternoon, `0xf081`=Full Day), then **verified visually**
against a rendered page image. All 231 markers reconcile to 170 priced rows with no
unassigned markers. NEW (†) flags were derived by sampling the red text color of each
row; 54 camps are NEW.

**Session-date discrepancy resolved.** The live site's URL slugs are stale 2025 dates
(`session-1-june-2-6`), but every page *title* matches the brochure (`Session 1: June
1-5`). The brochure dates are used. A Charlotte Parent aggregator listing "June 2
through August 1" reflects those stale slugs and is **wrong** — noted since it is the
figure a non-official source would give.

**Live-page caveat.** The live "Dates & Rates" and per-camp detail pages are currently
404 (the 2026 season has ended; the brochure says the 2027 edition arrives in December).
Category taxonomy, camp descriptions, and Family Night hours therefore come from January
2026 Wayback snapshots of the official site — official content, archived. Categories
matched 139 of 170 rows; the remaining 18 camp names were not in the archived session
snapshots, so their categories are classification from the camp name — TO VERIFY.

Closure days: "no camps June 19 and July 3" — making S3 and S5 four-day weeks (priced
lower accordingly).

Hours: Morning 9am–12pm, Afternoon 1–4pm, Full Day 9am–4pm. Days are Mon–Fri except S3
and S5. Grades are **rising** grades.

**Wrap-around care: earliest drop-off 7 a.m. (Before Care), latest pickup 6 p.m.
(After Care) — an 11-hour maximum span.** Two camps carry their own extended hours:
Charger Chill Day Camp (8am-5pm) at $590 and PD Girls Basketball Camp of Champions
(8am-12pm).

Location: 5800 Sardis Road, Charlotte, NC 28270; phone (704) 887–7006; email
pds.summer@providenceday.org.

Facilities (from the About page): expanded dining hall with outdoor patio, outdoor turf
field, new outdoor blacktop with basketball hoops, and upgraded music/art/technology
spaces. The **McMahon Fine Arts Center** (also called McMahon Performing Arts Center)
hosts CreativeKids productions and auditions; tickets are $5 at the door.

Program partners: **CreativeKids** (a PD partner since 1996) and **SmArt Educational
Art**, alongside PD teachers and coaches. The school states it has run camps "For 30
years."

Production show dates: Madagascar JR. — Friday, June 26, 7 p.m. and Saturday, June 28,
2 p.m.; Shrek JR. — Friday, July 17, 7 p.m. and Saturday, July 18, 2 p.m.

Health: no physical exam or immunization record required; a health history is completed
at registration. "A Registered Nurse or licensed Athletic Trainer" staffs the Health
Room 9 am-4 pm daily.

**Lunch:** "Lunch by Flik Dining is INCLUDED in your tuition for campers who are here
all day" — i.e. full-day camps or two half-day camps in the same session. "snacks are
included in EVERY camp!" Families may pack alternatives for dietary needs/allergies.

Registration fee: $50 non-refundable per family per season. Late/walk-in registration
fee: $50 administrative charge.

**Sibling discounts, multi-week discounts, and deposit policy: NOT PUBLISHED.** The only
discount the school describes is Complete Care being a bundled rate ($220/week vs $120
+ $120 separately). Payment is due in full at registration, so there is no deposit
structure — accepted methods are Visa, MasterCard, Discover, and eChecks.

sections.text:
- **Registration opens:** "Registration opens January 20 at ProvidenceDay.org/Summer"
 (stated twice — brochure cover and back page). providenceday.org/summer 301-redirects
 to summer.providenceday.org.
- Registration deadline: "Online registration closes at 9am on the Friday prior to the
 start of each camp session. Walk-in registration is available on the first day of camp
 only; a $50 administration fee applies for each late registration."
- Refund/cancellation: "Refunds are available up to 14 days prior to the start of camp;
 a $50 administration fee will be charged for any refunds." A tuition-credit option is
 available without the fee. No refunds for late arrival or early departure; the
 registration fee is non-refundable.
- **Open to non-PD families: Yes** — "We welcome the Charlotte community and surrounding
 areas." (Exception: Global Online Academy is PD-students-only.)
- Minimum age: "We welcome children who are at least four years old by January 1, 2026."
 The About page states campers ages 4.5 to 18.
- **Sell-out patterns:** the school does not publish per-camp fill rates or waitlist
 data. It does say "The selections have been carefully curated and the favorites fill up
 fast" and urges families to "start planning your summer NOW!" Specific sell-out data:
 NOT PUBLISHED.
- Production-camp auditions: CreativeKids production camps require auditions —
 "Saturday, May 16, 11 am-1 pm OR Sunday, May 17, 1-3 pm", held in the McMahon
 Performing Arts Center. Once cast, "parents are asked to enroll their child in camp
 within two weeks".
